summary: INNOVATE Corp. filed an 8-K reporting completion of the disposition of a controlling interest in its Broadcasting segment. On September 1, 2026, HC2 Broadcasting Holdings Inc. merged with CONX Broadcast Group, LLC, then converted to a Delaware LLC. INNOVATE retained an indirect minority interest via HC2 Broadcasting Holdco, which holds one of three board seats, while CONX Broadcast appoints two directors, gaining control. The LLC agreement grants HC2 Holdco minority protections like consent rights on fundamental actions, plus tag-along, drag-along, and rights of first offer. A Tenth Amendment extended the MSD credit facility maturity to December 31, 2026. No price, premium, or advisor disclosed. What to watch: governance of retained stake and refinancing risk.
